title: The wrong train
summary: Leo falls asleep on a train and wakes up somewhere he did not plan to visit.
paragraphs: Leo had a job interview in Seville at eleven o'clock. He got up early, put on his best shirt and caught the 7.15 train. The {{carriage}} was warm and quiet, and after ten minutes his eyes started to close.

When he woke up, the train was standing still. Outside the window there was a small station with flowers on the {{platform}} and a sign that said "Zafra". Leo had never heard of Zafra. He looked at his phone. It was half past nine, and he was going in the wrong direction.

He jumped off the train and ran to the ticket office. A woman with glasses was eating a sandwich. "The next train to Seville?" she said. "There's one at two o'clock." Leo felt {{sick}}. He would miss the interview.

He sat on a bench and called the company. He was sure they would be angry. Instead, a man laughed. "Zafra? My mother lives there," he said. "Can you do the interview on video? We can start at eleven, as planned." Leo looked around. There was a café across the street with free wifi.

At eleven o'clock, Leo sat at a table in the café with a coffee and his laptop. The interview went well. He talked about his {{experience}}, and when they asked about a difficult moment at work, he told them about the train. Everybody laughed. A week later, he got the job. Now, every time he takes a train, he sets an {{alarm}} on his phone, just in case.

carriage.meaning: one of the parts of a train where passengers sit

platform.meaning: the place in a station where you get on and off trains

sick.meaning: ill, or feeling very bad because something is wrong

experience.meaning: knowledge or skill you get from doing a job

alarm.meaning: a sound from a clock or phone that wakes you or reminds you

questions.question: Why did Leo end up in Zafra?
options: He took a train to the wrong city on purpose.
He fell asleep and missed his stop.
He wanted to visit the station.
questions.explanation: His eyes started to close, and when he woke up he was going in the wrong direction.

questions.question: When was the next train to Seville?
questions.explanation: The woman in the ticket office said there was one at two o'clock.

questions.question: How did the man from the company react?
options: He was angry and cancelled the interview.
He laughed and suggested a video interview.
He told Leo to take a taxi.
He changed the interview to the next week.
questions.explanation: He laughed, mentioned his mother lived in Zafra and asked Leo to do the interview on video.

questions.question: What does Leo do now when he travels by train?
options: He always sits near the door.
He sets an alarm on his phone.
questions.explanation: Every time he takes a train, he sets an alarm on his phone, just in case.
